name: au-fuel-tax-credits
description: Use this skill to prepare or review an Australian fuel tax credit claim for a GST-registered sole trader, partnership, company or trust for 2026-27, or a late 2025-26 claim: Fuel Tax Act 2006 entitlement, the 4.5 tonne GVM and environmental tests, the rate on the acquisition date and its changes during the year, the road user charge for heavy vehicles, apportionment, simplified methods for claims of $10,000 or less, records, adjustments, error corrections and BAS labels 7C and 7D. Trigger on "fuel tax credits", "FTC", "road user charge", "label 7D", "off-road diesel" or "basic method for heavy vehicles".
